--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Fix the demo launch: start acp-agent with the acp subcommand'
+---
+## What
+`ACPDemoSession` (`Sources/DemoSupport/ACPDemoSession.swift`) calls `AgentProcess(command:)` with no arguments. The default subcommand of `acp-agent` is `run` (`AcpAgentCommand` in FoundationModelsACPAgent). Thus the agent does not speak ACP. Source: update.md §9.1.
+
+- [ ] Pass `arguments: ["acp"]` when the agent command is `acp-agent`. Keep the arguments of other commands unchanged. Put the default arguments in `DemoLaunchOptions` (`Sources/DemoSupport/DemoLaunchOptions.swift`).
+- [ ] There is no `--acp` flag. Change the tests in `Tests/AgentViewKitACPTests/ACPThreadActionsTests.swift` that use `--acp`.
+- [ ] Make sure that the README text for `--agent-command` is correct (`README.md`), and run `Scripts/check-readme.sh`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The demo launch of `acp-agent` gives the arguments `["acp"]`.
+- [ ] No test or document uses the `--acp` flag.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add a test in `Tests/AgentViewKitACPTests/ACPDemoSessionTests.swift`: with a `FakeProcessLauncher`, the launch of `acp-agent` records the arguments `["acp"]`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitACPTests` passes.
+- [ ] `Scripts/check-readme.sh` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #acp-client
\ No newline at end of file
